intro_walkthrough: Establish the editor with the game view and HUD visible.
outro_walkthrough: Hold on the completed editor view.

source.before: Resizing the browser could leave the game view at its boot size and overlay handles out of alignment.
source.after: The live game view grows or shrinks with the browser, every overlay handle stays on its element, and the engine reports both virtual console size and true backing-store pixels.
source.value: The editing-size readout and the HUD stay aligned with the picture on screen.

treatments.text: Resizing now keeps your game and HUD aligned.
walkthrough: Show the game view before changing the browser size.
Resize the browser while keeping the game view and HUD handles visible.
Hold on the resized view with a HUD handle aligned to its element.

source.before: The editor had no Pause or Resume control, so lining up the HUD meant waiting for a useful demo frame.
source.after: Pause and Resume sit beside the demo selector and follow the engine's real state, including console changes and an honest disabled reason on unsupported backends.
source.value: You can stop on a quiet frame and adjust the HUD without losing the moment you wanted.

treatments.text: Pause keeps engine frames steady for HUD edits.
walkthrough: Load a demo with Pause visible beside the demo selector.
Pause on a quiet frame and hold while the demo clock stays still.
Resume and hold while the demo clock advances again.
